sentences.text: Huginaspis was an extinct genus of arthrodire fish, a group of armored jawed vertebrates.
The genus Huginaspis was first described by Heintz in 1929.
Huginaspis is classified as a member of the class Placodermi, known as placoderms.
It belongs to the family Phlyctaeniidae.
Three species are currently recognized within the genus: Huginaspis australis, Huginaspis broeggeri, and Huginaspis vogti.
These fish lived during the Early Devonian to Middle Devonian periods.
Fossils of Huginaspis have been found in Spitsbergen, Norway, and Queensland, Australia.
